name: rOpenSpain/Siane
what_it_holds: R package to represent Spanish INE statistical data on official Spanish administrative maps (choropleth), pulling from INE and IGN. General-purpose, not tourism-specific; no Frontur/Egatur/EOAT mentioned explicitly.
why_useful: Confirms rOpenSpain ecosystem has INE-linked mapping/data tooling; could be adapted to visualize/pull regional tourist-apartment (EOAT) figures if INE exposes them through the same generic series interface, but not verified.

name: dnme-minturdep/armonizacion
what_it_holds: 48-commit Distill/R site titled 'Harmonización de las Estadísticas de Turismo en las Provincias' (harmonizing Argentina's provincial tourism statistics), hosted at armonizacion.yvera.tur.ar; a companion technical-document repo (DT6_ciencia_de_datos_turismo) from the same org documents the methodology in TeX.
why_useful: Government methodology + likely underlying provincial-level tourism data for Argentina, feeding LatAm regional-split forecasting (gap 7); worth a follow-up clone-free look at the repo's data/ folder for committed CSVs.
